div.head: Hu 7
div.ab: In hundredo sicut in alio (omni) placito uolumus, ut rectum (et ius) pupplicum iudicetur in omni causa, et adterminetur, quando hoc impleatur.
On hundrede swa on oðer gemote we wyllað, þæt mon folcriht getæce æt ælcere spǽce, ⁊ andagie, hwænne man þæt gelæste.
In centenariis necnon et in aliis placitis uolumus, ut puplica rectitudo (teneatur uel) decernatur in omni causa (inter uirum et uirum), et ut inducietur, donec perficiatur (rectitudo).
On hundrede swa on oðer gemote we wyllað þæt mon folcriht getæce æt ælcere spǽce, ⁊ andagie hwænne man þæt gelæste.
In the hundreds, as in the other courts, it is our will that every case be treated in accordance with the public law and have a date fixed for its decision.
In the hundred, as in any other court, it is our will that in every suit the common law be enjoined, and a day appointed when it shall be carried out.
Im Hundred wie im anderen Gericht wollen wir, dass bei jeder Klage Volksrecht angeordnet und Termin gestellt werde, wann man das [Urtheil] erfüllen werde.
In the hundred as in any other court we will that folk-right be ordered in every suit, and a term be set for when the [judgment] is to be fulfilled.
div.note: Liebermann compares I Ew Pr.; II [Ew] 8.
